Feature

STRUCTURAL REINFORCEMENT

Perimeter reinforcements that provide greater resistance to the high torsional forces the racket must withstand during play

SMART HOLES LINEAL

The arrangement of equidistant holes in groups of three reinforces the impact surface and improves the durability of the racket.

FIBERGLASS

Soft touch, greater comfort, and excellent ball output on all shots

Padel racket adidas 2026 World Cup Argentina

The adidas Padel World Cup 2026 Argentina racket has been specially created for the 2026 World Cup, to be held across the United States, Mexico and Canada.

It is designed for players looking for a comfortable, stable and easy-to-handle padel racket, ideal for maintaining control and consistency throughout the match. Its balanced performance builds confidence on every shot and supports a steady game both from the baseline and at the net.

The design, inspired by the colours of the Argentine national team, reflects an intense and emotional way of competing, where every point is played with commitment and personality. A padel racket aimed at intermediate players who enjoy the game through consistency and passion for competition.
